description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'LanguageNegotiationContentEntity' that handles language negotiation based on content entity routes and query parameters. It implements outbound URL processing, route condition checks, and provides language switch links, specifically for content language negotiation in Drupal.

classes.name: LanguageNegotiationContentEntity
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for content language negotiation based on entity routes and request parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with the entity type manager from the container.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Retrieves the language code from the request query parameter.

methods.name: processOutbound
methods.description: Processes outbound URLs to add language query parameters and prevent URL rewriting.

methods.name: getLanguageSwitchLinks
methods.description: Generates language switch links with appropriate query parameters.

methods.name: hasLowerLanguageNegotiationWeight
methods.description: Determines if this negotiation method has higher priority based on configuration weights.

methods.name: meetsContentEntityRoutesCondition
methods.description: Checks if the current route matches the content entity route condition.

methods.name: getContentEntityTypeIdForCurrentRequest
methods.description: Gets the content entity type ID associated with the current request route.

methods.name: getContentEntityPaths
methods.description: Retrieves all content entity link template paths and their entity type IDs.
